resources.string: Convert SD1.5 and SDXL image models to run on your phone’s Qualcomm AI processor.

Save the downloaded CLIP and VAE files so you do not have to download them again. These files help the model understand prompts and read or create images. Restore the ZIP after reinstalling or on another phone. The original download ZIP works too.

resources.string: The main image model comes from your file. Prompt reading and image decoding use shared CLIP and VAE files, so results may differ from the original model.
The first SDXL conversion downloads about 1 GB of shared files. Later conversions reuse them.
Too long — keep it under 80 characters.

LoRAs are combined with the model during conversion. They do not slow down image generation, but each combination needs its own conversion. Changes to the text encoder are not included, so style LoRAs may work better than ones that depend on trigger words.
Building the model for your phone…
The screen stays on while the app is open. Conversion continues if you switch apps.
Saved to %1$s. Open your image app and import it as a custom model.
Your converted model includes shared files for reading prompts and decoding images. SD1.5 uses DreamShaper files; SDXL uses the files downloaded on first use.
SD1.5: 512 × 512 images, built for Snapdragon 8 Gen 2. SDXL: 1024 × 1024 images, built for Snapdragon 8 Gen 3. Both have worked on a Galaxy S25 Ultra. Other phones are not yet confirmed.
